name: Paradium.AI Inc. Common Stock
summary: Paradium.AI, Inc., formerly The Arena Group Holdings, Inc., is a brand, data and intellectual property company that operates a portfolio of digital media brands. The company combines technology and storytelling to create content verticals across sports, leisure, lifestyle, and finance, monetizing audience engagement through its unified digital publishing platform. Its owned and operated brands include Parade, TheStreet, Men's Journal, and Athlon Sports.
